name: DashCore
description: An Android64 validation toolkit for Geometry Dash. DashCore measures gameplay frame costs, validates scene traversal and bounds, samples triggers and grouped objects independently, records per-object protection flags and invalid-bound fallbacks, and checks a Bismuth-inspired GLES compute visibility mask. Live render culling remains hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (diagnostic only)
experimental-render-culling.description: Inactive in DashCore 0.7.6. Live object hiding remains disabled while parent-transformed, raw-rectangle, and node-local bounds are compared. The setting is retained for compatibility.
